purpose: Twelve animated visual-style examples for the repository homepage, including eight newly added style samples.
identity: All characters depict the repository owner, director Merlin (@导演梅林君), using his authorized illustrated likeness. These are examples, not identity templates for new users.
method: The original four examples are retained unchanged. This expansion adds eight styles drawn with built-in image_gen, six independently drawn poses each, followed by local alignment, Chinese typography and transparent GIF encoding.
reference_privacy: Original photographs, private filesystem paths and conversation logs are not distributed. Full prompts and descriptive reference roles are included.
limitations: Twelve-style demonstration, not a complete WeChat submission album.
480px GIFs are display previews; companion 240px GIFs are chat-size versions. Static PNGs are single frames and retain their recorded dimensions.
Playback-frame counts do not imply separately drawn images for every frame.
Technical, decoded-pose and actual browser playback checks are separate; pending checks are not passes.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production animation sprite sheet for ONE animated portrait sticker. Reference image is the sole identity AND illustration style master. Keep the exact same adult slender male likeness, narrow face, visible high forehead, messy parted ear-length dark hair, large black rounded-square glasses, thin moustache and long pointed chin goatee. Polished big-head caricature with realistic recognizable face, small adult body, bold clean black outline, detailed shading; NEVER generic child or another man. A single 1536x1024 landscape image divided invisibly into 3 columns and 2 rows: exactly 6 sequential FULL-BODY poses, 512x512 each, read left to right top row then bottom. In each cell use same fixed camera, consistent face/body size, fixed foot baseline around cell y=448, centered at cell x=256. All art (hair, hat, feet, arms, props) must stay within x=52..460 and y=36..454 of each 512px cell; generous empty margins. Smooth subtle successive poses for animation, preserve clothing and prop geometry consistently. Full body and props visible, no cropping, no inter-cell overlap. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, borders, gridlines, panels, background scenery, floor or cast shadows. Request genuinely transparent alpha backdrop; if real alpha cannot be delivered use PERFECTLY FLAT pure #00FF00 chroma-key green background, including all gaps. NEVER simulated checkerboard. No green in any subject or props (use navy instead of green/teal when needed).
SCENE: Black hoodie, glasses. Mini filmmaking setup: one handheld small clapperboard, camera hanging at waist. Blank board no writing.
SIX FRAMES: clapper open; raises board; clapper begins closing; clapper shut with small motion lines; amused director nod; opens clapper again.
Do not draw any caption. Clapper board is BLANK with simple black/white striped hinge, all six poses same position, small changes in hand/hinge/head only.

Preserve his narrow oval face, black rectangular glasses, slim curved eyebrows, small mustache and pointed chin beard/goatee, warm smile. No yellow cap or safety vest. Dress him in a loose pale teal-blue sweater.
STYLE IS THE MAIN REQUIREMENT: delicate traditional WATERCOLOR STORYBOOK illustration on a transparent background, as if painted by hand with water and pigment. Visible thin irregular pencil/brush contours, softly bleeding watercolor edges, uneven pigment pooling and granulation, translucent pale blue-green and warm peach washes. Loose expressive painted black hair rather than individual realistic hairs. Gentle pastel violet/yellow flowers, organic handpainted shapes. Adult face should be recognizable but interpreted in a charming children's picture-book language. It MUST look like 2D watercolor, NOT 3D, not clay, not plastic, not crisp vector, not glossy anime or photographic rendering. Do not paint any paper rectangle or background texture outside the subject; real alpha transparency around the silhouette and between arms.

3. begins nodding thanks: head tilts forward, eyelids half-closed, bouquet held steady.
4. deepest small polite bow, closed smiling eyes, shoulders lowered, bouquet held in both hands.
5. head rises with a delighted smile, offers bouquet gently forward with both hands.
6. returns bouquet close to chest, head almost upright and eyes softly open, naturally reconnecting to pose 1.
